## Description {#details}

The µOS++ intrusive doubly linked lists classes.

Intrusive lists are doubly linked lists that keep the two pointers inside each linked object.

The intrusive lists can be defined by instantiating the <code><Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/utils/intrusive-list">micro&#95;os&#95;plus::utils::intrusive&#95;list</Link></code> class template.
